sourceLimitations: Registry package tarballs can contain compiled native artifacts or generated code; their contents are not automatically complete corresponding source.
The linux-x64-gnu Argon2 binary package has no registry gitHead. The included wrapper source revision is version-associated but exact binary build correspondence is unverified.
The registry gives no gitHead for @types/node 24.19.1, helmet 8.3.0 or toad-cache 3.7.4.
Pinned Node and Nginx base images also contain OS packages whose exact source packages and build recipes must be inventoried for each distributed image.
